in-scope.item: Load builder definition from backend FormVersion.DefinitionJSON when opening /forms/{formId}/builder (no mock template by default).
Save Draft: persist the current FormDefinition into FormVersion.DefinitionJSON via existing authenticated versioning endpoints.
Backend schema validation enforced on save; validation errors surfaced safely in UI.
Builder Preview uses token flow: create PREVIEW token and open /forms/{token}, rendering from stored DefinitionJSON.
Establish DB as source of truth for renderer contract; localStorage may remain as optional fallback but not primary pipeline.

out-of-scope.item: Lead persistence, attribution, and submission processing.

dependencies.dependency: Backend FormVersion storage and endpoints (Story 3.1) - backend/modules/forms/version_router.py

problem.note: Builder currently initializes with a mock template and localStorage persistence, causing all forms to look identical and preventing end-to-end UAT of Story 3.8.
Public renderer consumes FormVersion.DefinitionJSON; without builder persistence to FormVersion, renderer cannot be validated against authored definitions.

save-draft.note: Implementation may choose create-new-version-per-save or update-latest-draft; must be deterministic.

public-preview-links.note: PREVIEW tokens should resolve to latest version to support design-time preview without publishing.

definition-json.note: FormDefinition remains the single source of truth for authored layout, components, and logic rules. Persistence writes/reads the same structure to/from FormVersion.DefinitionJSON.
